title: ggxy-ggZH-ampcache: an exact amplitude cache for the POWHEG-BOX-V2 process ggxy_ggZH
description: Patch and C++ hash map that memoise the one- and two-loop squared amplitudes of the POWHEG-BOX-V2 process ggxy_ggZH (gg -> ZH at NLO QCD, arXiv:2603.15762) across POWHEG's event reweighting. Event generation with a list of scale and PDF weights becomes about 24 times faster, with bit-identical events and weights (450 events, 397800 weights compared). Includes the generator of the patch and the closure-test tool with its results.
